PHOTOGRAPH, VIDEO, AND VOICE RELEASE

Riverbend Community Foundation
77 Water Street, Providence, Rhode Island 02903

I am at least 18 years of age. In consideration of my participation in the program named below and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt of which I acknowledge, I grant Riverbend Community Foundation and its successors, assigns, and licensees (together, "Riverbend") the following permissions.

1. Grant of Rights.

I grant Riverbend the irrevocable, perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free right to photograph, film, and record me, and to use, reproduce, edit, publish, distribute, display, and create derivative works from my name, likeness, image, voice, and statements, in whole or in part, alone or with other material, in any medium now known or later developed, for the purposes described in Section 2.

2. Permitted Purposes.

Riverbend may use the material for its own charitable, educational, fundraising, promotional, and archival purposes, including on its website and social media, in newsletters and annual reports, in grant applications, and in press materials. Riverbend may not sell or license the material to a third party for that party's own advertising, and may not use the material to endorse a commercial product or service.

3. No Approval Right.

I waive any right to inspect or approve the finished material or the use to which it is put, and I understand that Riverbend has no obligation to use the material at all.

4. No Compensation.

I understand that I will receive no payment or other compensation for the permissions I grant, now or in the future.

5. Release.

I release Riverbend from any claim arising out of the use of the material permitted by this release, including any claim for defamation, invasion of privacy, right of publicity, or emotional distress, except for a use outside the scope of Section 2 or a use made after I withdraw this release under Section 6.

6. Withdrawal.

I may withdraw this release as to FUTURE uses by giving Riverbend written notice at the address above or at privacy@riverbendcf.org. Withdrawal does not require Riverbend to recall, destroy, or stop distributing material already produced, printed, or published, and does not affect any use made before Riverbend receives my notice. Riverbend shall stop making new uses within thirty (30) days after it receives the notice, and shall remove the material from its own website and social media accounts within that period where it is technically able to do so.

7. Minors.

If I am signing on behalf of a person under 18, I represent that I am that person's parent or legal guardian and that I have the authority to grant these permissions on that person's behalf.

8. Governing Law.

This release is governed by the laws of the State of Rhode Island. Any dispute arising out of it shall be brought in the state or federal courts located in Providence County, Rhode Island.

9. Entire Agreement.

This release is the entire agreement between me and Riverbend on this subject and may be changed only by a writing signed by both of us. If any provision is unenforceable, the rest remains in effect. I have read this release and understand it.
